verses.text_uthmani: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

trs.20: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
trs.85: Exalted is He who holds all control in His hands; who has power over all things;
trs.22: Blessed be He in Whose hands is Dominion; and He over all things hath Power;-
trs.203: Blessed be He in Whose Hand is the dominion; and He is Able to do all things.

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ

trs.20: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
trs.85: who created death and life to test you [people] and reveal which of you does best––He is the Mighty, the Forgiving;
trs.22: He Who created Death and Life, that He may try which of you is best in deed: and He is the Exalted in Might, Oft-Forgiving;-
trs.203: Who has created death and life that He may test you which of you is best in deed.<sup foot_note=154994>1</sup> And He is the All-Mighty, the Oft-Forgiving;

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَـٰوُتٍ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ

trs.20: [And] who created seven heavens in layers.<sup foot_note=197575>1</sup> You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
trs.85: who created the seven heavens, one above the other. You will not see any flaw in what the Lord of Mercy creates. Look again! Can you see any flaw?
trs.22: He Who created the seven heavens one above another: No want of proportion wilt thou see in the Creation of (Allah) Most Gracious. So turn thy vision again: seest thou any flaw?
trs.203: Who has created the seven heavens one above another; you can see no fault in the creation of the Most Gracious. Then look again: "Can you see any rifts?"

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ

trs.20: Then return [your] vision twice again.<sup foot_note=197576>1</sup> [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
trs.85: Look again! And again! Your sight will turn back to you, weak and defeated.
trs.22: Again turn thy vision a second time: (thy) vision will come back to thee dull and discomfited, in a state worn out.
trs.203: Then look again and yet again: your sight will return to you in a state of humiliation and worn out.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

trs.20: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils<sup foot_note=197577>1</sup> and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
trs.85: We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and made them [missiles] for stoning devils for whom We have also prepared the torment of a blazing fire.
trs.22: And we have, (from of old), adorned the lowest heaven with Lamps, and We have made such (Lamps) (as) missiles to drive away the Evil Ones, and have prepared for them the Penalty of the Blazing Fire.
trs.203: And indeed We have adorned the nearest heaven with lamps<sup foot_note=154995>1</sup>, and We have made such lamps (as) missiles to drive away the Shayâtîn (devils), and have prepared for them the torment of the blazing Fire.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

trs.20: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
trs.85: For those who defy their Lord We have prepared the torment of Hell: an evil destination.
trs.22: For those who reject their Lord (and Cherisher) is the Penalty of Hell: and evil is (such), Destination.
trs.203: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord (Allâh) is the torment of Hell, and worst indeed is that destination.

verses.text_uthmani: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ

trs.20: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
trs.85: They will hear it drawing in its breath when they are thrown in. It blazes forth,
trs.22: When they are cast therein, they will hear the (terrible) drawing in of its breath even as it blazes forth,
trs.203: When they are cast therein, they will hear the (terrible) drawing in of its breath as it blazes forth.

verses.text_uthmani: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ

trs.20: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
trs.85: almost bursting with rage. Its keepers will ask every group that is thrown in, ‘Did no one come to warn you?’
trs.22: Almost bursting with fury: Every time a Group is cast therein, its Keepers will ask, "Did no Warner come to you?"
trs.203: It almost bursts up with fury. Every time a group is cast therein, its keeper will ask: "Did no warner come to you?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ

trs.20: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"
trs.85: They will reply, ‘Yes, a warner did come to us, but we did not believe him. We said, “God has revealed nothing: you are greatly misguided”.’
trs.22: They will say: "Yes indeed; a Warner did come to us, but we rejected him and said, 'Allah never sent down any (Message): ye are nothing but an egregious delusion!'"
trs.203: They will say: "Yes, indeed a warner did come to us, but we belied him and said: ‘Allâh never sent down anything (of revelation); you are only in great error.’"

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

trs.20: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
trs.85: They will say, ‘If only we had listened, or reasoned, we would not be with the inhabitants of the blazing fire,’ and
trs.22: They will further say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we should not (now) be among the Companions of the Blazing Fire!"
trs.203: And they will say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we would not have been among the dwellers of the blazing Fire!"

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

trs.20: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation<sup foot_note=197578>1</sup> for the companions of the Blaze.
trs.85: they will confess their sins. Away with the inhabitants of the blazing fire!
trs.22: They will then confess their sins: but far will be (Forgiveness) from the Companions of the Blazing Fire!
trs.203: Then they will confess their sin. So, away with the dwellers of the blazing Fire!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ

trs.20: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
trs.85: But there is forgiveness and a great reward for those who fear their Lord though they cannot see Him.
trs.22: As for those who fear their Lord unseen, for them is Forgiveness and a great Reward.
trs.203: Verily,, those who fear their Lord unseen (i.e. they do not see Him, nor His punishment in the Hereafter), theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward (i.e. Paradise).

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

trs.20: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
trs.85: Whether you keep your words secret or state them openly, He knows the contents of every heart.
trs.22: And whether ye hide your word or publish it, He certainly has (full) knowledge, of the secrets of (all) hearts.
trs.203: And whether you keep your talk secret or disclose it, Verily, He is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts (of men).

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ

trs.20: Does He who created not know,<sup foot_note=197579>1</sup> while He is the Subtle, the Aware?
trs.85: How could He who created not know His own creation, when He is the Most Subtle, the All Aware?
trs.22: Should He not know,- He that created? and He is the One that understands the finest mysteries (and) is well-acquainted (with them).
trs.203: Should not He Who has created know? And He is the Most Kind and Courteous (to His slaves), All-Aware (of everything).

verses.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ

trs.20: It is He who made the earth tame<sup foot_note=197580>1</sup> for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
trs.85: It is He who has made the earth manageable for you––travel its regions; eat His provision- and to Him you will be resurrected.
trs.22: It is He Who has made the earth manageable for you, so traverse ye through its tracts and enjoy of the Sustenance which He furnishes: but unto Him is the Resurrection.
trs.203: He it is Who has made the earth subservient to you (i.e. easy for you to walk, to live and to do agriculture on it); so walk in the path thereof and eat of His provision. And to Him will be the Resurrection.

verses.text_uthmani: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ

trs.20: Do you feel secure that He who is above<sup foot_note=197582>1</sup> would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?<sup foot_note=197581>2</sup>
trs.85: Are you sure that He who is in Heaven will not make the earth swallow you up with a violent shudder?
trs.22: Do ye feel secure that He Who is in heaven will not cause you to be swallowed up by the earth when it shakes (as in an earthquake)?
trs.203: Do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven (Allâh), will not cause the earth to sink with you, and then it should quake?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ

trs.20: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
trs.85: Are you sure that He who is in Heaven will not send a whirlwind to pelt you with stones? You will come to know what My warning means.
trs.22: Or do ye feel secure that He Who is in Heaven will not send against you a violent tornado (with showers of stones), so that ye shall know how (terrible) was My warning?
trs.203: Or do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven (Allâh), will not send against you a violent whirlwind? Then you shall know how (terrible) has been My Warning.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

trs.20: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
trs.85: Those who went before them also disbelieved- how terrible was My condemnation!
trs.22: But indeed men before them rejected (My warning): then how (terrible) was My rejection (of them)?
trs.203: And indeed those before them belied (the Messengers of Allâh), then how terrible was My denial (punishment)?

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ

trs.20: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
trs.85: Do they not see the birds above them spreading and closing their wings? It is only the Lord of Mercy who holds them up: He watches over everything.
trs.22: Do they not observe the birds above them, spreading their wings and folding them in? None can uphold them except (Allah) Most Gracious: truly it is He that watches over all things.
trs.203: Do they not see the birds above them, spreading out their wings and folding them in? None upholds them except the Most Gracious (Allâh). Verily, He is the All-Seer of everything.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ

trs.20: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
trs.85: What force can help you if the Lord of Mercy does not? The disbelievers are truly deluded.
trs.22: Nay, who is there that can help you, (even as) an army, besides (Allah) Most Merciful? In nothing but delusion are the Unbelievers.
trs.203: Who is he besides the Most Gracious that can be an army to you to help you? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ

trs.20: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
trs.85: Who can provide for you if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in their insolence and their avoidance of the Truth.
trs.22: Or who is there that can provide you with Sustenance if He were to withhold His provision? Nay, they obstinately persist in insolent impiety and flight (from the Truth).
trs.203: Who is he that can provide for you if He should withhold His provision? Nay, but they continue to be in pride, and (they) flee (from the truth).

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

trs.20: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
trs.85: Who is better guided: someone who falls on his face, or someone who walks steadily on a straight path?
trs.22: Is then one who walks headlong, with his face grovelling, better guided,- or one who walks evenly on a Straight Way?
trs.203: Is he who walks prone (without seeing) on his face, more rightly guided, or he who (sees and) walks upright on the Straight Way (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism)?

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

trs.20: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."
trs.85: Say [Prophet], ‘It is He who brought you into being, He who endowed you with hearing, sight, and understanding- what small thanks you give!’
trs.22: Say: "It is He Who has created you (and made you grow), and made for you the faculties of hearing, seeing, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give.
trs.203: Say it is He Who has created you, and endowed you with hearing (ears) and seeing (eyes), and hearts. Little thanks you give.

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

trs.20: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
trs.85: Say, ‘It is He who scattered you throughout the earth, He to whom you will be gathered.’
trs.22: Say: "It is He Who has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered together."
trs.203: Say: "It is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him shall you be gathered (in the Hereafter)."

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

trs.20: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
trs.85: They say, ‘If what you say is true, when will this promise be fulfilled?’
trs.22: They ask: When will this promise be (fulfilled)? - If ye are telling the truth.
trs.203: They say: "When will this promise (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) come to pass if you are telling the truth.?"

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."
trs.85: Say, ‘God alone has knowledge of this: my only duty is to give clear warning.’
trs.22: Say: "As to the knowledge of the time, it is with Allah alone: I am (sent) only to warn plainly in public."
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "The knowledge (of its exact time) is with Allâh only, and I am only a plain warner."

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ

trs.20: But when they see it<sup foot_note=197584>1</sup> approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."<sup foot_note=197583>2</sup>
trs.85: When they see it close at hand, the disbelievers’ faces will be gloomy, and it will be said, ‘This is what you were calling for.’
trs.22: At length, when they see it close at hand, grieved will be the faces of the Unbelievers, and it will be said (to them): "This is (the promise fulfilled), which ye were calling for!"
trs.203: But when they will see it (the torment on the Day of Resurrection) approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will change and turn black with sadness and in grief and it will be said (to them): "This is (the promise) which you were calling for!"

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

trs.20: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered:<sup foot_note=197585>1</sup> whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
trs.85: Say, ‘Just think- regardless of whether God destroys me and my followers or has mercy on us- who will protect the disbelievers from an agonizing torment?’
trs.22: Say: "See ye?- If Allah were to destroy me, and those with me, or if He bestows His Mercy on us,- yet who can deliver the Unbelievers from a grievous Penalty?"
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Tell me! If Allâh destroys me, and those with me, or He bestows His Mercy on us - who can save the disbelievers from a painful torment?"

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
trs.85: Say, ‘He is the Lord of Mercy; we believe in Him; we put our trust in Him. You will come to know in time who is in obvious error.’
trs.22: Say: "He is (Allah) Most Gracious: We have believed in Him, and on Him have we put our trust: So, soon will ye know which (of us) it is that is in manifest error."
trs.203: Say: "He is the Most Gracious (Allâh), in Him we believe, and in Him we put our trust. So you will come to know who it is that is in manifest error."

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ

trs.20: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
trs.85: Say, ‘Just think: if all your water were to sink deep into the earth who could give you flowing water in its place?’
trs.22: Say: "See ye?- If your stream be some morning lost (in the underground earth), who then can supply you with clear-flowing water?"
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Tell me! If (all) your water were to sink away, who then can supply you with flowing (spring) water?"
